instructions: Which support queue should handle this ticket?

criteria.billing: Invoices, charges on the account, plan prices
criteria.payment_failed: A card or bank payment was declined or failed
criteria.login: Cannot sign in: sessions, two-factor codes, locked accounts
criteria.password_reset: Forgotten password or a reset link that does not work
criteria.bug: The product behaves wrongly or shows an error
criteria.feature_request: Asks for something the product does not do yet
criteria.data_export: Exporting or downloading the customer's own data
criteria.integration: API keys, webhooks, connections to other tools
criteria.device_delivery: Delivery of an ordered hardware device
